entry.name: mc.downsamp~
entry.description: downsamp~ samples and holds a signal received in the left inlet at a rate set by an argument to the object of the value received in the right inlet, expressed in samples. No interpolation of the output is performed.

messages.name: float
messages.digest: Set the sample rate used to downsample
messages.description: In right inlet: Sets the sample rate used to downsample the input signal. You can specify the number of samples with floating-point values, but theobject will sample the input at most as frequently as the current sampling rate.
